title: AI customer support agents
content: AI customer support agents use natural-language processing and approved support information to answer customer questions. Their answers should be grounded in relevant business sources.

title: Business-specific AI agents
content: A business-specific AI agent can use a company's reviewed knowledge base to respond with information relevant to that business. The information can include policies, product details, and support guidance.

title: Customer support automation
content: Customer support automation can help answer recurring questions by retrieving approved answers from FAQs and support documents. Escalate questions that need a person or are not covered by the available information.

title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation
content: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) retrieves relevant information from a knowledge source and provides it as context to a language model. RAG can help ground generated answers in current business information without fine-tuning the model.

title: Business documents and FAQs
content: Business documents and FAQs can provide an AI support agent with product guidance, policies, and answers to common questions. Keep this information accurate, reviewed, and appropriate to share with customers.

title: Product information retrieval
content: An AI support agent can retrieve product descriptions, feature details, and troubleshooting guidance from a business knowledge base. Include verified product information and update it when product details change.

title: AI-powered customer service
content: AI-powered customer service combines automated responses with access to relevant support information. Clear source references and a human escalation path help customers verify answers and get assistance when needed.
